description: In a PA model in the fixed ambient universe, the specified bound-transport program converts an accepted proof of a signed bounded-quantifier formula with evaluated numeral bound into an accepted proof with the original closed term bound, for either quantifier and either sign. The body and terms are those of the supplied shared-syntax formula.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.SignedBoundTransport.certified_transportBound
  {M : Type} [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA] {α : Type} [Fintype α] {r : ℕ} (universal negative : Bool)
  (name : α → Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program r)
  (t : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Term α)
  (D : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (α ⊕ Unit))
  (pQuant : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program r) (x : Fin r → M)
  (hq :
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.Certified
      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.axiomVerifier (pQuant.value x)
      (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundTermTransport.quantifiedValue universal
        negative
        ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedSyntaxPrograms.slotFormula 0 name
              D).value
          x)
        (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.NumericalProofs.numeralSyntax
          ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.NumericalProofs.namedTermValue name
                t).value
            x)))) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.Certified
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.axiomVerifier
    ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.SignedBoundTransport.transportBound universal
          negative name t D pQuant).value
      x)
    (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundTermTransport.quantifiedValue universal
      negative
      ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedSyntaxPrograms.slotFormula 0 name
            D).value
        x)
      ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.NumericalProofs.namedTermCode name t).value
        x))
